caption: 建模期最常见的四类报错（本地实测原样）：词法错误、EOF 不配对、多实体同源的重定向、CSV 列名与物理列不符
alt: 终端显示四条 CAP 报错：Mismatched #、Mismatched EOF、can't auto-redirect、no column named
src: 本地实测：npx cds compile / npx cds deploy（cds-dk 9.9.6）；长行已截断
title: jason@MacBook-Pro: ~/Desktop/work/training/sap-cap/project-code/demo-node
lines: $ npx cds compile db/schema.cds srv/no_redir.cds --to edmx
“BookOrderService.OrderItemView” to select the entity as redirection target for
$ npx cds deploy --to sqlite:db.sqlite      # CSV 表头写成 orders_ID
SqliteError: in cds.deploy(): table sap_training_bookorder_BookOrderItems has no column
[ERROR] c6.cds:8:39-40: Unmanaged associations can't be used in expressions in queries
$ npx cds compile /tmp/cdserr/nokey_view.cds --to edmx    # 服务里暴露无主键视图
[ERROR] nokey_view.cds:3:20: Expected entity to have a primary key (in entity:“e.S.V”)

callouts.text: 1. 位置精确到列，先看报错行
2. 报错里直接给了修复注解名
3. CSV 表头 = 物理列名，写错就整批回滚
